mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in UNRATE above 4.8% triggers short-term market uncertainty as investors anticipate weakening labor demand, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing the 4.8% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in federal funds rates alongside a decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals tightening monetary policy and weakening demand, creating recessionary pressures that drive negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases AND GDPC1 decreases over 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite both FEDFUNDS rising and GDPC1 declining in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 240) in a context of near-zero federal funds rates amplifies market volatility, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate prolonged high inflation.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 240 in this regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO signals robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to rise significantly when INDPRO is in an upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in HOUST below 1200 indicates weak housing demand, triggering short-term market uncertainty and negative 5-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive despite HOUST falling below 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in job growth (PAYEMS) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate reduced economic growth.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls AND UNRATE rises over 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite both PAYEMS declining and UNRATE rising in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: Prolonged weakness in labor market participation (PAYEMS < 145,000 for 3 months) signals persistent economic stagnation, driving negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate continued job market challenges.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite sustained low labor market participation.
